bubbles.title: Inventory build
bubbles.hint: Found: tsc→skills/bubble/scripts (per-file, committed, drift-tested); tsc→skill-install/ runs as npm 'install' lifecycle script (fires on every npm ci); site = 3 tsc runs + build.mts (copies, ?v= hash, import map, cli-sources.json); bubble-web/machine.mts regex-rewrites ESM→CJS and runs it via new Function. CLI only needs node:fs, node:path, process, console; no module-level state. CI on Node 18 (.nvmrc, EOL).

bubbles.title: Compare build tools
bubbles.hint: Candidates (npm, 2026-10): esbuild 0.28 node>=18; rollup 4 node>=18; vite 8 / rolldown node>=20.19; tsup 9 / tsdown node>=22.18. Proposal: esbuild for CLI, installer and site; tsc --noEmit for types; browser bundle aliases node:fs/node:path to memfs and injects process/console, so machine.mts's esmToCjs/runCommonJs go away.

bubbles.title: Add esbuild
bubbles.hint: Done: esbuild 0.28.2 devDep; build.mjs drives every build (cli | site | check); npm scripts build/site/check; npm 'install' lifecycle script removed.

bubbles.title: Migrate CLI build
bubbles.hint: Done, changed course: esbuild strips all comments from the committed JS agents read, so tsc keeps the per-module CLI + installer emit (byte-identical), now run via build.mjs; test/build.test.js builds through build.mjs.

bubbles.title: Export CLI main
bubbles.hint: Done: src/lib/cli/main.ts exports run() (argv/env/exitCode via process); src/cli/bubble.ts just calls run().

bubbles.title: Replace web bridge
bubbles.hint: Done: build.mjs plugin resolves bubble-cli → src/lib/cli/main.ts and node:fs/node:path → bubble-web/node-fs.mts, node-path.mts; globals.mts is esbuild's inject for process/console; host.mts holds the per-run host (withHost). esmToCjs, runCommonJs, Sources and cli-sources.json are gone. Parity test green, and fails when a shim breaks.

bubbles.title: Migrate site build
bubbles.hint: Done: build.mjs site → dist/pages/{index.html, main-<hash>.js, style-<hash>.css, .nojekyll}; story inlined via define STORY; build.mts, sources.mts, ?v= and the import map are gone. Site tsconfigs are noEmit (npm run check). Verified on Node 18.

bubbles.title: CI + docs
bubbles.hint: Done: CI unchanged (npm ci installs esbuild from the lockfile; npm test / npm run site call build.mjs). Docs: AGENTS.md, src/site/README.md, docs/1, docs/6 (main.ts split), docs/8 (bridge + build rewritten), page footer. esbuild warnings are fatal so a missing fs shim fails the bundle. 59/59 on Node 18 and 22, and with FORCE_COLOR=1.
